beats.say: A fake payment page can be an exact copy of the real one.
Logo, colours and buttons are the same. The difference is in the address bar and in what it asks for.
The padlock proves nothing either: most fake sites have one.
The safest way: open the portal from your bookmark or type the address yourself.

scenes.prompt: Is this page genuine or fake?

cards.explain: This is the portal's own domain and you opened it yourself. This is where to check fines.
The domain is different and the page wants everything at once: card, code and SMS code. It is a theft form.

body.text: 1 fine is registered in your name. Details: Fines section in the app.

cards.explain: The notice is inside the official app and has no link. Check and pay the fine right there in the app.
Receiving money never needs the code on the back of your card. State benefits do not need registration through a link.
No payment page ever asks for your card PIN. The PIN is only for cash machines and card terminals.

scenes.title: The fine link
scenes.intro: A friend sent you a fine link and you opened it. Make the right call at each step in the browser.

actions.label: Pay with the discount
actions.feedback: The discount is there to rush you. Now see what the page asks for.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right, this is not the portal's own domain. Now open the portal yourself.

steps.say: The page wants the card and the SMS code together.

actions.label: Pay: 40 AZN
actions.feedback: Your card details went to scammers. Call the bank now on the number on your card.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Good call. You typed nothing, now check the fine on the official portal.

steps.label: Fines: no active fines
steps.say: You opened the portal from your bookmark.

actions.label: View fines
actions.feedback: Right. The official portal shows no fine, so the link was fake.

actions.label: Tell your friend
actions.feedback: Great. Tell the friend who sent it not to type anything there.

steps.label: Family support: registration ends today
steps.say: This time a neighbour sent you a benefit link.

actions.label: Register
actions.feedback: This form collects card details. State benefits never need registration through a link.

actions.label: Close the tab
actions.feedback: Right. Check any benefit only on the official portal.

actions.label: Report the fake site
actions.feedback: Great. Reporting helps get the fake site blocked for others too.

scenes.prompt: Match what the page asks for with what it means.

pairs.right: No payment page ever asks for it
Approves a payment: read the amount first

pairs.left: Card back code to receive a benefit
A discount if you pay today
pairs.right: Rushing you to pay without checking

scenes.explain: If you are unsure, do not pay. Check the official portal yourself or call the police on 102.

points: Read the address bar: logo and padlock prove nothing.
A page asking for your PIN, or a card code for a benefit, is fake.
